CompactGaugeDerivative proves a GENERAL ACTUAL identity: for analytic f:E->WeightedCoeff w p and analytic theta:E->Coeff infinity, let d=exp(-theta)*f. Then d is analytic, and Df-M_exp(theta)*Dd = [m |-> m*f(q)] composed with Dtheta(q). This difference is compact for EVERY finite Banach exponent. All derivatives are FULL complex Banach derivatives; no compactness or summable derivative bound is assumed. The compactness follows from the FIXED actual vector f(q) and the bounded-symbol derivative.
